Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

surge hemingway · evaluates: Hemingway-bench’s creator article reports more than five thousand blind pairwise comparisons, scoring holistic writing quality and eight subdimensions including intent, creativity, truthfulness, coherence, instruction following, verbosity and humor.

Permanent record ID: candidate.add17.hemingway.comparisons.v2

  • Judges also explain their preferences; later model personas are interpretations of those explanations rather than additional benchmark units or a numerical scoring formula.
